scope: Data-definition amendment only; it does not alter E0/E1 outcomes, model weights, intervention operators, thresholds, budgets, or statistics.
authorization: Applied before any CholecSeg8k E2 intervention result is generated, because the source dataset has semantic rather than instance masks.

cholecseg8k.mask_encoding: Validate equal-RGB watershed colours, convert once to indexed semantic masks, and retain source_video on every manifest row.
cholecseg8k.unit_of_analysis: One semantic foreground class within one 80-frame clip. Background (class 0) is never prompted or evaluated as an object.
cholecseg8k.prompt: For each eligible clip-class unit, use its first frame with that class labelled foreground; use the same first-labelled-frame policy and prompt_offset + 7 target interval as region_tokens_v1_1.
cholecseg8k.analysis_population: All eligible clip-class units from all source videos; source_video is retained for clustered descriptive reporting.

method_split.leakage_rule: No source video may occur in both method splits, including through different clips or semantic classes.

cholecseg8k.empty_or_short_units: Record and exclude a clip-class unit if it has no foreground frame or no eligible target after the fixed post-prompt interval; never substitute another class or lower the target interval.

reporting: Report counts by source video, clip, class group, eligibility, and skip reason. Do not generalize a clip-level semantic result to an instance-tracking result.
